name: 24121 · Moneta, VA
findings: ZIP 24121 (Moneta) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24121 (Moneta) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 24121 (Moneta) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
